name: EBMUD High School Summer Internship (HSSI)
city: Oakland, CA and EBMUD service area
what_you_do: You get a paid 6 week summer internship at the water utility. It is about 16 hours a week.
who_can_apply: High school students in the EBMUD service area. For 2026 the East Bay program took students referred by partner groups. The Maintenance track (Stockton) required age 16 by June 24, 2026.
duration: 6 weeks, mid-June through August, about 16 hours a week
deadline_text: 2027 details are not posted. East Bay recruiting usually starts in January or February. In 2026 the East Bay program took referrals from partner groups only.
how_to_apply: The page does not yet say how to apply for 2027. In 2026 you could not apply directly for the East Bay program. These partners referred students: ACE Mentor, Biotech Partners, Eden Area ROP, Girls Inc. of Alameda County, Youth UpRising. Email internships@ebmud.com, (510) 287-0710.
notes: Mokelumne programs ran in 2026 in Lodi (Fisheries), Valley Springs (Ranger) and Stockton (Maintenance). Review was rolling. They usually start to look for interns in February or March.
